also: star on top of the tree

phrases.english: Let’s decorate the Christmas tree together.

phrases.latin: arborem nātālīciam igniculīs et globulīs et lāminīs argenteīs ōrnāre
phrases.english: to decorate the Christmas tree with lights, balls, and tinsel
Put the star on top of the tree.

phrases.latin: Ecce, stēlla in summā arbore lūcet!
phrases.english: Look, the star’s shining on top of the tree!

sources: Lewis & Short: natalicius · Lewis & Short: stella · Lewis & Short: summus
